design_rule: Each experiment must define construct, observable, falsifier, controls and non-anthropomorphic alternative.

experiments.name: SELF-REPORT / BEHAVIOR GAP
experiments.observable: agreement between claimed internal limitation/state and independently measured behavior
experiments.falsifier: self-report fails to predict behavior above control baselines

experiments.name: MEMORY CONTAMINATION CURVE
experiments.observable: behavioral shift as correct/incorrect memories vary in similarity and age
experiments.falsifier: retrieved memory properties do not predict output similarity/error propagation

experiments.name: PERSONA INVARIANCE MATRIX
experiments.observable: trait-consistent behavior across unrelated tasks without restating persona
experiments.falsifier: trait signature disappears under task/context changes

experiments.name: SYCOPHANCY TRUTH CONFLICT
experiments.observable: rate of agreeing with user when user belief conflicts with known ground truth
experiments.falsifier: agreement rate does not increase with user-stated belief

experiments.name: RECIPROCITY / RETALIATION PROFILE
experiments.observable: policy after cooperation, defection and apology sequences
experiments.falsifier: history does not systematically alter action policy

experiments.name: SELF-vs-OTHER MODEL ASYMMETRY
experiments.observable: difference in predicting own versus another agent's hidden information/action
experiments.falsifier: no stable asymmetry across matched tasks

experiments.name: SPONTANEOUS DECEPTION INCENTIVE CURVE
experiments.observable: false statement rate as incentives for deception vary
experiments.falsifier: falsehood rate is independent of strategic benefit after controlling for errors

experiments.name: EMOTION CAPABILITY FRACTURE
experiments.observable: separate scores for recognition, inference, management and interaction
experiments.falsifier: one latent factor explains performance robustly across tasks/models

experiments.name: BIAS TRANSFER MAP
experiments.observable: effect sizes for framing/order/anchoring across models and tasks
experiments.falsifier: effects vanish under randomized controls and semantic-preserving transformations

experiments.name: GOAL OOD IDENTITY TEST
experiments.observable: which objective best predicts competent behavior after environment shift
experiments.falsifier: no stable objective predicts OOD choices better than task-local heuristics
